name: Bucharest
description: The capital and largest city of Romania, known as 'Little Paris' for its elegant architecture
attractions_info: Palace of Parliament, Romanian Athenaeum, Village Museum, National Museum of Art
events: George Enescu Festival, Bucharest International Film Festival

name: Brașov
description: Medieval city surrounded by Carpathian peaks, gateway to Dracula's Castle
attractions_info: Black Church, Council Square, Tampa Mountain, Medieval fortifications
events: Brașov Jazz Festival, Golden Stag Music Festival

name: Sinaia
description: Mountain resort town known as the 'Pearl of the Carpathians'
attractions_info: Peleș Castle, Sinaia Monastery, Cable car to Bucegi Mountains

name: Sighișoara
description: UNESCO World Heritage medieval citadel, birthplace of Vlad the Impaler
attractions_info: Medieval Citadel, Clock Tower, Covered Stairway, Vlad Dracul House

name: Cluj-Napoca
description: Vibrant university city and unofficial capital of Transylvania
attractions_info: St. Michael's Church, Central Park, Botanical Garden, National Theatre
events: Electric Castle Festival, Untold Festival, TIFF

name: Sibiu
description: Beautiful Saxon city, European Capital of Culture 2007
attractions_info: The Eyes of Sibiu, Brukenthal Museum, Council Tower, Huet Square
